title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
summary_lines: Preview Ultrafast, a new OpenAI API service tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster. Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.
